name: Tokita Soujin
source:
A swordsman who lost his memories as well as his family in the previous war. He has been taken under the care of the Inou house and is currently working at a flower shop in town. 
He is proficient in wielding a sword and serves as an assistant instructor at the dojo. Even without a lord to serve, he does not neglect his training. He is an honest warrior.

[spoiler]His actual identity is [i]Mitsurugi[/i] (ミツルギ), a human-shaped magical weapon created by [url=/c83842]Himi no Mikoto[/url] at the sacrifice of 888 miko just before the final battle with [i]Ko no Kuni[/i] (胡ノ国). Another identity is named [i]Ame no Mitsurugi[/i] (天御剣), which is one of the Three Artifacts.[/spoiler]
